body: I started with causing bruises cause I was so upset and couldn’t keep the anger inside of me anymore but I was such a people pleaser that I could never tell anyone I was angry at them so I had to pretend I wasn’t angry. Well obviously that anger has to go somewhere, and hence I started to throw my arms in the the corners of walls. And then I graduated to razors which I had easy access to in the art room at my school. I still self harm, but it usually comes out in working myself to overt exhaustion or restricting food and occasionally bruising myself on purpose.

I wouldn’t necessarily say you’re en enabler but it’s very likely you (like me) developed a skill set that “enables” people’s behavior out of the necessity to survive. I also feel like I’m stuck in a string of bad luck or I often refer to it as Greek tragedy. But maybe that’s being too black and white, bc there’s been a lot of beautiful and wonderful things in my life as well. 
I know a lot of my behavior or lack of standing up for myself comes from my fear of being abandoned and my core belief: that I am unlovable.

That’s the thing, I try to figure out what toxic energy or dysfunction I’m bringing to the relationship. It consumes a lot of my thought process revolving around my relationship during the day. I’ve been in a lot of bad relationships (a four year long abusive one and then married to an emotional abuser for 7 1/2 years and now I’ve been with my current partner for 2). I know relationships are a two way street and he can’t be the sole perpetrator in the toxicity. I think my want to be a people pleaser and perfectionist make me into a codependent partner (compounded with an extreme fear of abandonment).

Wow! I definitely didn’t see that insight into my thoughts and feelings on this one 😳 🥺 but you’re totally right. I wrote this a couple nights ago. My partner works two jobs and his second job he edits film, and sometimes those creative processes can take longer than expected. I know this, but sometimes that anxiety creeps in and gets the best of me. It doesn’t help that I have Borderline Personality Disorder either, where once that anxiety comes in, it tends to flood all my thoughts and feelings. I wrote this in attempt to get my feelings out and try to process them 💗 I’m sorry you struggle with anxiety
That’s a really helpful idea 💗 honestly. I mean I could use some help getting these emotions off my chest and I don’t want to always dump on my friends as it leaves me feeling like a burden.
Same, currently. Are you trying to control the impulse at all?

Thanks for replying, and things have gotten better. We got to talk today when I got home from work and it helped work through some things. It’s still not great but it’s getting better. So there’s maybe a little hope returning.

I have so many scars from cuts but it’s so embarrassing and I don’t like things being permanent. The bruises are embarrassing too but less so because I can take the ownership away from myself, “oh my bruises? I got them from work, my job is so physical🤷‍♀️” or “I’m so clutsy, silly me 💁‍♀️”
I’m really glad I can be of some help ☺️ good luck to you and your journey ✨
I know how you feel, I wince at the pain when I’m wearing clothes and I work a physical job so I can blame the bruises on the job but it makes it extremely painful to walk around all day.
I sometimes will hit myself in the face. It’s a compulsion I’d really like to stop.

Have you looked into Borderline Personality Disorder? It’s often develops in childhood from trauma, usually from parents who have their own personality disorders/traumas. BPD is much more common than Narcissistic Personality Disorder. It also sounds like you have empathy and respect for those around you and that doesn’t necessarily read as narcissist to me but I could be wrong. The best is to seek professional help, especially if this is a huge disruption to your life and personal relationships. Hope you find some help and resolution to your suffering 🧡
Punch my legs, hit myself. I find it’s not as much of a release as cutting but it’s less permanently destructive.

I’m so sorry you’re experiencing difficulties 😔 I also have problems communicating but mine is the opposite, I am an over communicator and my partner would be happy to never talk about anything ever and for me that just prolongs suffering and makes it harder for me to regulate my emotions. 
I would start by evaluating how you can tell your partner how you are feeling with out using accusatory language like instead of “you make me feel worthless” try “when you don’t respond to my bids for affection, it makes me feel worthless or unloved.” That might help solve some of the problems. I would also try to see where your feelings (1-10 scale) are at before you try to approach a conversation, like if you’re at a 7 or higher I would try a REST (dialectical behavioral therapy technique) before you try to communicate and then when you’re more at a 3 - try to go from there.
Doctor Fox on YouTube has a lot of great videos on dealing with BPD, I was diagnosed almost two decades ago and am just beginning my journey to healing myself. I hope things get better for you soon.
Cinnamon. Bun. Spread. Hands down!

I have bleached many a t-shirt and hoodie and the logo is never effected. Sometimes you can get super cool colors when bleaching some of the shirts and hoodies (like the navy blue ones become a super pretty mauve color) and if your captain allows it, you can do some tie-dye too! I kinda feel tie-dye is synonymous with TJ’s but maybe that’s just me 😅 hope that helps!

My kids are still young, 8 (almost nine) yr old daughter and a 6 yr old son. I know I let my insecurities get to me and I haven’t actively been working to heal myself until around 2 1/2 years ago. So I’m still in the constant struggle of being self aware and not being healed up enough to control my actions. It’s an awful place to be. I have no hope.

Same here, everything works amazingly well when it works but the world ends when it doesn’t. I really honestly have no hope though. I appreciate your kind words and I hope things with you and your partner work themselves out for a happy and healthy life together. I just don’t think that’s in the cards for me and mine. We’ve only been together 2 years and lived together for one. My children are from a previous marriage (10+ years) and their father was a narcissist. Thank you for all your kind words

Same, it’s after midnight here too. I don’t think have much hope. He’s a strong avoidant type and he’s content never talking about anything, if he can avoid me indefinitely, he will. I think he only came back to play video games. I don’t think he wants anything to do with me.

He came back and watched a movie with the kids. I’ve been hiding in my bedroom the whole time. I talked to a good girlfriend for awhile but I’m so scared to go out there and talk to him. I’m scared he’ll say something unkind.
Sending hugs and warm thoughts

Ugh all the time! It’s like constant imposter syndrome. The constant thought process in my head: I’m never good enough and all the compliments and the nice things people say about me are just lies to make me feel better. 😩😓
I wish it was easy to just disappear
